planner_baseline.name: sparopt
planner_baseline.note: Registry baseline retained locally before patches; current patched bytes are separately bound by the actual compiled inventory and design source map. No version upgrade.

source_method: Read-only retained RDFLib source and pinned Rust dependencies; no original Python executed. Frozen research records remain historical source-derived proposals and are not rewritten as implementation or acceptance receipts.
implementation: One existing parser, planner, Dataset, expression compiler and six arithmetic kernels. Preserve nonempty source chains through direct algebra transport; fetch first and entire raw tail before math; one capture per source chain. Append variants to retain old discriminants. Keep bounded integral state and compiler-certified integral Decimal arithmetic children.

private_entry.entry_visibility: hidden public Rust item only when its nondefault feature is selected for cross-crate internal receiving

limits: Only bounded integer inputs and compiler-certified integral Decimal arithmetic children; every division intermediate must be exact and integral.
External Decimal/float/date, complete numeric subtype and lexical rules, arbitrary integers and Decimal context precision/rounding remain open.
Multiplicative results requiring negative Decimal zero fail explicitly before the sign can be lost; this is a capability gap, not original Python refusal.
A Decimal reread through a variable after BIND does not inherit arithmetic-child certification. Bare i64::MIN source spelling remains unqualified; no blanket claim over all i64 lexical forms.
Only chains reaching the legacy expression compiler are refused; ordinary optimizers may remove an unreachable branch first. Conservative chain arms do not qualify the full optimizer.
Original context thaw/forget/remember, full joins/groups/functions/aggregates, raw bindings and Semantica wrapper, whole original library and engineering adoption remain open.
qualification: This file declares source identity and implementation boundaries. It is not a current test, real ggen, installation, release or engineering qualification receipt; previous accepted records retain their own source identities.
